description:
Create a new user group in the Vicidial administration panel with the following settings:

- User Group (ID): PRMSALES
- Group Name: Premium Sales Division
- Group Level: 7
- Forced Timeclock Login: Y
- Shift Enforcement: START
- Allowed Campaigns: All Campaigns (select the 'ALL CAMPAIGNS' option from the list)

The Vicidial admin panel is open in Firefox at http://localhost/vicidial/admin.php (credentials: 6666 / andromeda).

To complete this task:
1. Navigate to 'User Groups'.
2. Click 'Add A New User Group'.
3. Enter the Group ID 'PRMSALES' and Group Name 'Premium Sales Division', then Submit.
4. You will be redirected to the detailed modification page.
5. Set 'Group Level' to 7.
6. Set 'Forced Timeclock Login' to Y.
7. Set 'Shift Enforcement' to START.
8. In the 'Allowed Campaigns' section, select 'ALL CAMPAIGNS -' and add it.
9. Ensure you submit/save changes after configuring these settings.
